subtopics.title: Population Growth and the Demographic Cycle

questions.question: The only two forces that can change a population's size are:
options: NATURAL GROWTH (births minus deaths) and MIGRATION (arrivals minus departures)

questions.question: A country with 30 births and 12 deaths per thousand residents has a natural growth rate of:
options: 18 per thousand — one comma eight percent a year

questions.question: In the EARLY EXPANDING stage of the demographic cycle:
options: Birth rates fall while death rates rise
Both rates are low and stable
Death rates collapse first — water, immunisation, antibiotics — while birth rates stay high, so the gap produces explosive growth
Migration is the only source of growth

questions.question: Birth rates begin falling in the LATE EXPANDING stage because:
options: Families urbanise, girls stay in school longer, contraception spreads, and children become school fees rather than farm hands

questions.question: The strict definition of unemployment requires a working-age person to be:
options: Without work, AVAILABLE for work, and ACTIVELY LOOKING for it — all three at once

questions.question: Discouraged work-seekers are people who:
options: Want a job but have abandoned the search — dropped by the strict definition, restored by the EXPANDED definition
Have retired early on a pension

questions.question: The labour force participation rate divides:
options: The LABOUR FORCE by the WORKING-AGE population — what fraction of the potential workforce has stepped into the arena
The labour force by the number of firms

questions.question: The durable shapes of South Africa's labour force are:
options: An ageing workforce concentrated in rural areas
Equal unemployment rates across all age groups
A YOUNG workforce with youth joblessness far above the overall rate, jobs stacked in metropolitan engines, and participation held down by discouragement

subtopics.title: The Demand and Supply for Labour

questions.question: Labour demand is called DERIVED demand because:
options: Firms hire people for the OUTPUT they generate — nobody demands electricians unless somebody first demands wiring
It is derived from government statistics
Workers calculate it from their wages
It never responds to the business cycle

questions.question: In the labour market, the roles are reversed from the goods market:
options: Firms supply labour and households buy it
HOUSEHOLDS supply labour, FIRMS demand it, and the WAGE is the price they negotiate

questions.question: The labour supply curve slopes upward because:
options: Higher wages tempt more people into the market and more hours from those already in it

questions.question: The SKILLS MISMATCH describes:
options: A schooling pipeline delivering too little of what firms hunt for, while millions carry abilities the economy absorbs weakly — the structural core of SA unemployment

questions.question: "Definition first" means:
options: State WHICH definition produced a figure — strict and expanded can stand millions apart — before interpreting it

questions.question: The youth unemployment rate divides young jobless people by:
"Look under the headline" reminds you that:
options: Only the headline rate is assessed
A single national rate flattens the real story — joblessness piles up among the young, the unskilled and particular provinces, where data-response questions live

questions.question: Commentary counts as ANALYSIS rather than description when it:
options: Repeats the largest figure in the table
Rounds every number to the nearest ten
Traces the figure back to its mechanism — demand, supply, skill or geography

questions.question: Mvubu Street's complete population change equals:
options: Babies born minus funerals, plus families who moved in minus families who left — natural growth plus migration
The number of residents with jobs

questions.question: "The clinic opened at the corner and the street swelled" is the story of:
options: Chapter two — funerals thinning out while the cradles kept coming
Chapter one — cradles and funerals balancing

questions.question: The one sentence that unlocks the entire term is:
options: The street's residents are all retiring
Every December another large matric class walks out of the school hall and into the job queue — measured against the jobs opening to receive it

questions.question: Uncle Vusi — jobless, four applications this month, checking the notice board daily — is:
options: On the team, on the bench: officially UNEMPLOYED under the strict definition

questions.question: Ayanda, a full-time matric learner, is:
options: NOT on the team sheet — full-time learners stay outside the labour force

questions.question: Cousin Sipho — wants work but quietly stopped applying — is:
options: Struck off the strict team sheet, but counted by the EXPANDED measure — thousands of real Siphos fill the gap between the counts
Too old for the working-age group

questions.question: Sipho's silent withdrawal registers statistically as:
options: A rise in the strict unemployment rate
A FALL in participation — discouragement lowers it while leaving the strict unemployment rate untouched

subtopics.title: The Wage Is a Price at a Gate

questions.question: At the factory gate, the market's counter is spun around:
options: FAMILIES sell hours, muscle and know-how; FIRMS buy them — the wage is where the two sides shake hands
Firms sell jobs and families buy them with fees
The state buys all labour first
Nobody sells anything at a gate

questions.question: "No orders, no shifts" is the street translation of:
options: DERIVED demand — the firm wants what workers MAKE, so the gate widens and narrows with its customers' orders

questions.question: The artisans' gate and the general-labour gate demonstrate:
options: That all wages equalise in the end
That queues are the same length everywhere
One town holding opposite labour markets, separated only by SKILL — short queue and strong pay at one, long queue and a wage near the floor at the other
That firms never compete for workers

questions.question: "A trade certificate works like a boarding pass" means:
options: Certificates guarantee a job for life
Training carries a worker from the long queue to the short one — the crossing over the skills mismatch
